description: This file defines the VTTaskQueue class, which manages a queue of workflow tasks that are scheduled for execution based on time. It provides methods to add tasks to the queue and retrieve tasks that are ready to run.
external_files: pquery method of the database adapter

classes.name: VTTaskQueue

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the queue with a database adapter object

methods.description: Retrieves tasks that are scheduled to be executed based on the current time
